How to Structure an Authentic Muslim Nikah Matrimonial Biodata

An Islamic Nikah biodata emphasizes modesty, Deen (religious observance), academic and professional integrity, Biradari/family background, and clear Wali (guardian) contact information without astrological/horoscope sections.

Biodata SectionEssential Fields & Cultural AttributesWhy Families Expect It
1. Sacred Islamic OpeningBismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim or Assalamu Alaikum header with Crescent / Arabesque emblemBegins the Nikah proposal with traditional Islamic etiquette and grace
2. Personal & Deen ProfileFull Name, Age & Height, Sect / Maslak (Sunni Hanafi, Shafii, Ahl-e-Hadith, Shia, etc.), Biradari, Prayer (Salah), Fasting & Hijab/Beard observanceHelps families align on religious practice and daily lifestyle values
3. Qualification & CareerAcademic Degrees, Islamic Education (Hifz/Alim if applicable), Profession, Employer, and City/CountryPresents worldly and religious education clearly on a single A4 page
4. Family & Wali ContactFather & Mother Details, Married/Unmarried Brothers & Sisters, Native Hometown, and Wali Phone/WhatsApp & AddressFacilitates respectful family-to-family communication through the Wali

Frequently Asked Questions — Muslim Nikah Biodata Format

Common questions about creating, customizing, and downloading your Muslim Nikah Biodata Format in PDF, Word (.docx), and HD PNG formats.

Does the Muslim Nikah preset automatically hide horoscope and Kundali fields?

Yes. Selecting the Muslim / Nikah preset automatically disables astrological fields and replaces them with Islam-appropriate fields including Religion & Sect (Maslak), Biradari, Religious Practice (Namaz/Roza), and Wali Contact Person.

Can I create a no-photo Muslim marriage biodata for privacy?

Absolutely. Uncheck "Include Photo on Biodata" in Tab 2 or filter by "No-Photo Formats" in the gallery to generate a clean, text-only Islamic matrimonial profile.

Are Urdu script labels supported for Nikah biodata?

Yes. You can switch the Label Language dropdown to Urdu (اردو) or English at any time without losing your typed details.

Can I share the Nikah biodata directly on family WhatsApp groups?

Yes. Click the WhatsApp button to share a formatted matrimonial text summary or download the 300-DPI PDF and HD PNG card for instant sharing.
